**⚠️ Before you submit**

- RENEX is end-to-end encrypted. **Do not paste any user IDs, message contents, or session keys** into issues. The server can't decrypt them anyway, and they may identify you.
- Security-sensitive bugs: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — do **not** open a public issue.
